records: Regulatory clarification: CFTC Letter 26-05 (Feb 6, 2026), issued in response to Coinbase Financial Markets, provides a conditional staff no-action pathway for FCMs relying on it to account for non-security digital assets accepted by a registered DCO, subject to that DCO's valuation/haircuts and other conditions. The Dec 8, 2025 pilot release's BTC/ETH/USDC restriction applies during each FCM's initial three-month phase; secondary legal reporting says asset restrictions can expand after that phase. Do not state XRP is categorically excluded from CFTC collateral frameworks. Actual FCM reliance notices, post-initial-phase policies, XRP customer collateral balances and Bitnomial utilization remain unverified; the March 20 FAQ's full text has not yet been directly reviewed.
